title: Installation Jobs Reschedule Tariff: Notice, Fee and Credit Figures by Method
content:
This tariff schedule lists the reschedule figures of **Installation Jobs** for each installation method: the notice a customer reschedule needs, the fee figure for a late reschedule, the count limits, and the notice and credit figures that apply when Ridgeline itself moves a crew date.

## Customer reschedules

| Installation method | Notice before the booked crew arrival (hours) | On-time customer reschedules per job without a fee | Late reschedule fee (USD) | Customer reschedules per job before branch manager approval is needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | 48 | 1 | 150.00 | 3 |
| Full-Frame Installation | 48 | 1 | 175.00 | 3 |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | 48 | 1 | 175.00 | 3 |
| Masonry Opening Installation | 72 | 1 | 225.00 | 3 |
| Bay and Bow Installation | 72 | 1 | 250.00 | 3 |
| Door System Installation | 48 | 1 | 150.00 | 3 |

## Ridgeline's own moves of a crew date

| Installation method | Notice Ridgeline gives before the booked crew arrival (hours) | Company reschedule credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | 48 | 75.00 |
| Full-Frame Installation | 48 | 100.00 |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | 48 | 100.00 |
| Masonry Opening Installation | 48 | 125.00 |
| Bay and Bow Installation | 48 | 150.00 |
| Door System Installation | 48 | 75.00 |

## Failed-access visits in the counts

Under every installation method, a failed-access visit is counted as a customer reschedule toward both the free count and the maximum count in the first table.

## Notes to the schedule

- The customer notice figure is the notice a customer reschedule needs to count as on time; the late reschedule fee figure applies to a customer reschedule given with less than that notice, or beyond the free count.
- The company notice figure is the notice Ridgeline gives when it moves a crew date; less notice than that earns the customer a credit, whose figure is in the second table.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical example)

A hypothetical Masonry Opening Installation customer reschedule needs 72 hours of notice to count as on time, against 48 hours under Insert Pocket Installation; the late reschedule fee figure for Masonry Opening Installation is 225.00, and Ridgeline's company reschedule credit figure for the same method is 125.00.
